description: This file defines the Catalyst controller for managing tags and tag groups within the Coocook project. It includes methods for listing, creating, editing, updating, and deleting tags and tag groups, as well as generating submenu items for navigation.

classes.name: Coocook::Controller::Tag
classes.description: Catalyst controller class for managing tags and tag groups in the Coocook application.

methods.name: submenu
methods.description: Generates submenu items for navigation related to tags and tag groups.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Displays a list of tags grouped by tag groups, including 'other' tags not assigned to any group.

methods.name: new_tag
methods.description: Prepares data for creating a new tag, including URL and available tag groups.

methods.name: index_tag_group
methods.description: Displays a list of all tag groups with links to edit each group.

methods.name: new_tag_group
methods.description: Prepares data for creating a new tag group.

methods.name: tag
methods.description: Fetches a specific tag by ID for viewing or editing.

methods.name: tag_group
methods.description: Fetches a specific tag group by ID for viewing or editing.

methods.name: edit
methods.description: Prepares data for editing a specific tag, including related articles, dishes, and recipes.

methods.name: edit_group
methods.description: Prepares data for editing a specific tag group, including its tags.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a specific tag if deletable.

methods.name: delete_group
methods.description: Deletes a specific tag group if deletable.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new tag, optionally associating it with a tag group.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing tag with new data.

methods.name: update_group
methods.description: Updates an existing tag group with new data.

methods.name: redirect
methods.description: Redirects to the appropriate page after create/update actions.
